data.description: Framework bug in SorraAgents skill/code_review: the audit's code-quality scan passes the git changed-file list to EVERY linter, so ruff (Python-only) is invoked on .sh/.ts files and emits hundreds of bogus parse-error findings. The audit report embeds all findings, exceeding Linux 128KB argv limit; persist_audit then crashes with OSError [Errno 7] Argument list too long and the audit verdict is never persisted. Fix direction: per-linter file filtering by extension, or persist via wl audit-set --audit-file, or cap findings in the report. Workaround for WL-0MSRG481O007QVEA: manual persist via --audit-file. Discovered from: WL-0MSRG481O007QVEA.
data.title: audit persist fails with E2BIG when code-quality scan lints non-Python files (ruff on .sh/.ts)
